name: Kurosaki Shinobu
source:
Shinobu is another friend of Takaaki's, but the nature of their friendship is that they enjoy quarreling with each other, and Shinobu is quite good when it comes to arguing, so he actually enjoys talking about subjects he has an opposite opinion about. He is a sporty guy who is on the high school basketball team.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/xasy/xasy.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
